message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas – A Quick Reference Guide** | Topic | Key Points | Where to Find More Info | |-------|------------|------------------------| | **Speed Limits** | • General limit: 55 mph on rural roads, 45 mph on urban roads.
• 70 mph on interstate highways (except where posted otherwise).
• 65 mph on rural two‑lane highways. | Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT) – Speed Limit Regulations | | **Seat‑belt & Child Safety** | • All occupants must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child safety seat or booster.
• No “seat‑belt law” for drivers over 18, but all passengers must buckle. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Cell‑Phone Use** | • Hand‑held use while driving is prohibited.
• Hands‑free devices are allowed.
• Texting while driving is illegal. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood Alcohol Concentration (BAC) of 0.08% or higher is illegal.
• Zero‑tolerance for drivers under 21 (0.02% BAC).
• Penalties: fines, license suspension, possible jail time. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **Right‑of‑Way** | • Yield to pedestrians at crosswalks.
• Stop at red lights and stop signs.
• “Move‑over” law: vehicles must change lanes or slow down when approaching emergency vehicles. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **Parking & Loading Zones** | • No parking within 20 ft of a crosswalk or intersection.
• No parking in loading zones unless you’re loading/unloading.
• Parking in handicap spaces requires a valid permit. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **Towing & Vehicle Registration** | • Vehicles must display a valid registration sticker.
• Towing of vehicles requires a valid permit and proper equipment. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **School Bus Rules** | • All vehicles must stop for a school bus with its stop sign extended and lights flashing.
• No passing on either side of a stopped school bus. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **Lane‑Changing & Overtaking** | • Use turn signals.
• Do not cut off other drivers.
• Overtake only when safe and legal. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **Vehicle Safety Equipment** | • Headlights must be on from sunset to sunrise.
• Tires must have adequate tread depth (minimum 2 / 32 in).
• Brakes and mirrors must be functional. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **Insurance Requirements** | • Minimum liability coverage: $30,000 for bodily injury per person, $60,000 for total bodily injury, $25,000 for property damage. | Texas Department of Insurance – Motor Vehicle Insurance | | **Special Situations** | • **High‑way “Move‑over”**: Must change lanes or slow to 20 mph below the posted speed limit when approaching a stopped emergency vehicle.
• **School bus**: Must stop for both directions.
• **Construction zones**: Follow posted signs and reduced speed limits. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | --- ### How to Stay Updated 1. **Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT)** – Official website: [txdot.gov](https://www.txdot.gov) *Provides current speed limits, construction updates, and traffic regulations.* 2. **Texas Transportation Code** – Accessible via the Texas Legislature’s website: [statutes.texas.gov](https://statutes.texas.gov) *Full legal text of all traffic laws.* 3. **Texas Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV)** – For licensing, registration, and insurance requirements: [dmv.texas.gov](https://www.dmv.org/tx/) 4. **Local County Courts** – For recent case law and enforcement trends. --- ### Quick Tips for Texas Drivers - **Always check for posted speed limits** – they can vary significantly between rural and urban areas. - **Use hands‑free devices** if you need to talk on your phone. - **Keep your vehicle’s registration and insurance up to date** to avoid fines. - **Be extra cautious near school buses** – they have special rules. - **Observe “move‑over” signs** when approaching emergency vehicles. If you need more detailed information on a specific aspect (e.g., DUI penalties, insurance coverage details, or recent court cases), let me know!
